newsitem.title: USA: McDermott steps aside from Gingrich ethics case.
newsitem.headline: McDermott steps aside from Gingrich ethics case.

text.p: The top Democrat on the House ethics committee, at the centre of a storm over a leaked tape of a phone converation in which Speaker Newt Gingrich participated, said Tuesday he will step aside conditionally from consideration of the Gingrich ethics case.

Rep Jim McDermott said in a statement released by his congressional office that he would step aside "as soon as steps are taken to preserve the equal ratio of the committee" - now divided between five Democrats and five Republicans.
